svg.title: LayerFS 2.0 architecture
svg.desc: pi agents run in parallel, with an API plugin docked to them (Node and Python SDKs, CLI, MCP). File calls run in the agent's own process and commit straight to the Store. Bash calls go to the agent's own sandbox, whose LayerFS daemon mounts a Workspace, runs the command, commits and unmounts. Every daemon and SDK opens the one Store file; SQLite pushes and pulls to Google Drive, Cloudflare R2, MinIO or AWS S3, PostgreSQL connects to Cloudflare, AWS or Google Cloud. Finished tasks publish to Git and GitHub.
